summary_1line: Many kings gather for Yudhishthira’s Rajasuya sacrifice, are lavishly hosted, and are assigned roles as the grand ritual proceeds with immense wealth and honor.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rows of white mansions with golden latticed windows and pearl-hung interiors shine like snowy cliffs as gathered kings approach Yudhishthira’s sacrificial city.
Krishna humbly kneels washing the feet of Brahmanas while mighty kings and warriors stand around the grand Rajasuya hall.
A vast sacrificial compound crowded with jeweled palaces, kings bearing tribute, priests tending six sacred fires, and celestial chariots hovering above.
